name: jigged
description: Work in Jigged, the machine shop operations system, from ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription:
Jigged is the operations system for small precision machine shops: quotes, jobs, parts and routings, stock, shipping, outside processing and QuickBooks invoicing.

Connect Jigged and ask about your shop in plain words: which jobs are late and what material they are short, what a part costs to make, what is on a shelf, or what shipped last week. ChatGPT can also do the work: create and update customers, parts, quotes and jobs, convert a quote into jobs, move and adjust stock, ship a job, send work out to a vendor, import a spreadsheet, or push an invoice to QuickBooks. It asks before anything hard to undo.

It acts as you: it sees and changes only what your Jigged login can, under the same rules as the Jigged app. Only office logins can connect; shop-floor operator logins can't. Nothing it returns says who did a piece of work on the shop floor. Disconnect any time from Jigged's account menu.

Requires a Jigged account with an admin or user role.
